periods.time: After Bell returns from consulting Eina

name.zh: 赫斯缇雅完成贝尔Lv.2更新
name.en: Hestia Completes Bell's Lv.2 Status Update

periods.summary: Bell tells Hestia he will choose Luck. Hestia updates his Falna to Lv.2, records all basic abilities reset to I0, Luck I as his development ability, Firebolt as his magic, and the new skill Heroic Desire / Argonaut.
periods.cause: Bell has completed the last deliberation before his Lv.2 status rewrite.
periods.process: Hestia updates Bell on her bed, explains that level-up changes his vessel rather than producing an immediate physical sensation, then shows him his record sheet. Bell is thrilled to gain a skill, then mortified by the heroic wish implied by its name.
periods.outcome: Bell officially becomes Lv.2 with Luck I and Heroic Desire / Argonaut, though he and Hestia do not yet understand the skill's practical effect.
periods.aftermath: Hestia leaves for Denatus, where Bell's alias will be decided, while Bell expects a cool title like Ais's Sword Princess.
periods.significance: Defines Bell's new Lv.2 mechanical state and introduces Heroic Desire / Argonaut, a key personal skill tied to his heroic longing.
